type.description: The type of element. Generally maps to type of UI element. Unsupported is not show. Boolean is a checkmark. Collection is a searchable REST backed drop down. Date is a date picker. Enumeration is a searchable inline drop down. Information is just text. Section is a grouper or container with text. Text is a standard text box. Number is generally a text box, but serialized as a numeric. Object is grouping like section but with additional metadata. ObjectArray is a repeating grouping with additional metadata.
